events.title: Establishment of Ha Tinh Province
events.description: During the large-scale administrative reform of King Minh Mang, Ha Tinh division was separated from Nghe An town to establish Ha Tinh Province. This was a historical milestone that officially established the administrative boundaries of the province.

events.title: Outbreak of the Huong Khe Uprising
events.description: Phan Dinh Phung and Cao Thang chose the rugged mountainous region of Huong Khe and Vu Quang as their base to launch the Huong Khe Uprising. This was the largest, most tightly organized, and longest-lasting (10 years) uprising in the Can Vuong movement.

events.title: Battle of Vu Quang
events.description: Phan Dinh Phung's insurgent army relied on the rugged terrain and clever tactics to lure the enemy, defeating a large-scale attack by French troops and indigenous guards at the Vu Quang base, causing heavy casualties to the enemy. This was the most resounding victory of the uprising.

events.title: Establishment of the Ha Tinh Provincial Party Committee
events.description: The conference to establish the provisional Ha Tinh Provincial Party Committee was held at Thuong Tru ferry dock. The birth of the Party Committee directly led the struggle movement of Ha Tinh peasants during the Nghe Tinh Soviets movement.

events.title: The Nghe Tinh Soviets Movement in Ha Tinh
events.description: Peasants in Can Loc, Thach Ha, and Cam Xuyen Districts simultaneously protested, destroyed district offices, burned documents and records of the colonial and feudal government, and established self-governing Red Peasant Associations (Soviet administrations) in hamlets and communes.

events.title: Seizing Power in Ha Tinh
events.description: Ha Tinh was one of the first 4 provinces in the country (along with Bac Giang, Hai Duong, and Quang Nam) to seize power for the people during the August Revolution, before the General Uprising order from Hanoi arrived.

events.title: First Victory Against the US Air Force (Nai Mountain)
events.description: Air Defense Battalion 8, together with local militia, made outstanding achievements at the Nai Mountain battlefield, shooting down 9 US aircraft in their first battle against the US Air Force's escalation of the destructive war in North Vietnam.

events.title: The Sacrifice of 10 Female Youth Volunteers at Dong Loc Junction
events.description: At the fierce traffic bottleneck of Dong Loc Junction, 10 female youth volunteers of Squad 4 (Company 552) heroically sacrificed their lives while filling bomb craters to clear the road for trucks heading to the front lines. They became immortal symbols of revolutionary heroism.

events.title: Establishment of Nghe Tinh Province
events.description: Implementing the Resolution of the National Assembly, the two provinces of Nghe An and Ha Tinh were merged into Nghe Tinh Province. This was a period when the two provinces joined forces to build the economy and overcome the consequences of the war.

events.title: Re-establishment of Ha Tinh Province
events.description: The 8th National Assembly passed a Resolution to separate Nghe Tinh Province back into two provinces, Nghe An and Ha Tinh. Ha Tinh Province officially operated under the new administrative unit, beginning the process of Doi Moi and economic development.
